ContactPage.locationsValue: Dubai & Abu Dhabi. Other locations by arrangement.

ContactPage.nextStep2: We discuss your priorities, design direction and the work you are considering.

ContactPage.faq1Q: Do I need drawings before contacting you?
ContactPage.faq1A: No. Photos, a floor plan or a short description are useful if available, but you can start with a conversation.
ContactPage.faq2A: Yes. We can begin remotely and arrange a site meeting when needed.
ContactPage.faq3A: Yes, by prior arrangement so the relevant team can meet you.

HomeFamily.heading: Family-Led. Personally Involved.
HomeFamily.body: Our family business began in 2021, started by two brothers who came from large-scale construction. One has held chief engineer positions with UAE contracting companies on major residential, commercial and public buildings; the other has managed construction projects across several countries. Today they lead the engineering and project management of Bellvero Group, alongside a third partner responsible for client relations. Our own production makes bespoke cabinetry, glass and stone work.

HomeFaq.heading: Before We Begin
HomeFaq.ctaBody: Send us your project details and we will get back to you.
HomeFaq.existingDesignQ: Can I start with an existing design?
HomeFaq.existingDesignA: Yes. We can review your drawings and specifications and discuss renovation or joinery based on your designer's project.
HomeFaq.individualWorkQ: Do you take on individual areas of work?
HomeFaq.individualWorkA: Yes. Alongside complete projects, we undertake individual rooms, joinery orders and specialist services.
HomeFaq.locationA: Our main project locations are Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Contact us to discuss your property.
HomeFaq.budgetA: We clarify the scope and specifications, then prepare a proposal. Any additional work requires your approval before it proceeds.
HomeFaq.remoteQ: Can I follow the project remotely?
HomeFaq.remoteA: Your project manager shares photos, videos and written updates in a dedicated project group. The communication arrangements are agreed at the start.
HomeFaq.afterEnquiryA: Our client relations manager contacts you to discuss your plans. For renovation projects, we then arrange an initial site visit. The first discussion and initial renovation visit are complimentary.
HomeFaq.paymentA: The payment schedule is agreed before work begins and is recorded in the contract. It sets out the initial payment, the payments that follow and the conditions for each. Manufacturing and material purchases may be scheduled as separate payments.

ProcessPage.metaDescription: Ten clear stages from the first brief to inspection and handover, with a defined scope, approved changes and regular updates.
ProcessPage.title: From the First Conversation to Handover
ProcessPage.intro: A clear sequence, a dedicated project manager and agreed decisions at each stage. The route is adapted to your property and the services you commission.

stages.title: Brief & Initial Budget
stages.body: We discuss the property, your priorities, the intended scope and an initial budget direction.

stages.title: Site Review & Survey
stages.body: We review existing conditions and arrange the measurements required for the agreed stage.

stages.title: Concept & Layout
stages.body: We develop the agreed design direction, layouts and material palette, or review your existing design.

stages.title: Design & Technical Coordination
stages.body: We coordinate design drawings, services, specifications and the requirements of the next project stages.

stages.title: Scope, Quotation & Agreement
stages.body: The scope, exclusions, responsibilities, programme and commercial terms are recorded before the relevant work begins.

stages.title: Approvals & Preparation
stages.body: We prepare and coordinate the required submissions within the agreed scope and plan site access and mobilisation.

stages.title: Construction & Engineering
stages.body: Site works and engineering installations follow the agreed documentation, with site supervision and progress reporting.

stages.title: Production & Procurement
stages.body: Joinery is manufactured and agreed materials and products are procured in coordination with the site programme.

stages.title: Installation & Completion
stages.body: We coordinate final installations, finishing details and the preparation of the property for inspection.

stages.title: Inspection & Handover
stages.body: We inspect the agreed works, record outstanding items and arrange handover with the relevant project and warranty information.

ProcessPage.overlapNote: Some stages overlap. Production and procurement can run alongside site works, while quality checks continue throughout. Exact technical measurements for standalone joinery follow the agreement and precede production.
ProcessPage.routesHeading: Three Ways to Work With Us
ProcessPage.designOnlyBody: Brief, agreed design stages, review rounds and delivery of the design package. Support after delivery is commissioned separately.
ProcessPage.buildBody: We review your drawings and existing approvals, agree the implementation scope and coordinate the works.
ProcessPage.joineryBody: Brief and quotation, agreement, technical survey, drawings and samples, production and installation.
ProcessPage.decisionsBody: Your project manager coordinates communication. The site foreman oversees the works. Photos, videos and written updates are shared in the project group daily or every few days, according to the agreed reporting rhythm. Additional works begin only after approval of their scope and cost; any programme impact is discussed.
ProcessPage.decisionsRoleBody: One project manager for communication and reporting, one site foreman overseeing day-to-day execution.
ProcessPage.paymentBody: The payment schedule is agreed before work begins and is recorded in the contract. It sets out the initial payment, the payments that follow and the conditions for each. Manufacturing and material purchases may be scheduled as separate payments. Additional works are quoted and approved before they start, and are invoiced according to the same agreement.

WarrantyPage.metaDescription: A 36-month workmanship warranty on renovation and a 48-month warranty on our own bespoke joinery.
WarrantyPage.title: Warranty & Aftercare
WarrantyPage.intro: Clear responsibility after handover. Your project documents identify the work covered, the warranty period and the relevant product warranties.
WarrantyPage.renovationBody: Covers defects attributable to our workmanship within the agreed renovation scope, from documented handover of the relevant works.
WarrantyPage.joineryBody: Covers manufacturing and installation defects in cabinetry made and installed by Bellvero, from documented handover of the relevant items.
WarrantyPage.classificationNote: Engineering systems, glass and stone are classified in the contract according to the actual works and items.
WarrantyPage.productsBody: Appliances, hardware, upholstered furniture and other sourced products carry the warranty terms stated for those products. Normal wear, maintenance needs and damage caused by misuse or third-party alterations are assessed separately. The cause of a reported defect is reviewed before a decision is made. These terms do not remove any mandatory customer rights.
WarrantyPage.contactBody: Contact Bellvero with your project reference, a description and photos or video where possible. We record the issue, review the available information and agree the appropriate inspection or next step. Please avoid altering the affected area before assessment unless urgent action is needed for safety or to prevent further damage.
